gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: Reading into an array honors the character bound: with a limit of 1, asking for 1 character into the buffer returns 1.
ADDED i3: After resetting, skipping past the (empty) content and then re-marking, a single-character read reports EOF because there is nothing left to read.
ADDED i4: A negative character limit means no characters may be read, so reading into an array immediately reports EOF.
ADDED i5: Skipping returns the number of characters actually skipped from the source ("@</'" has 4 characters), and a subsequent read after the source is exhausted report
